name: Tower of Hananel
brief: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
short: The Tower of Hananel, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and mentioned in prophetic visions of the city's restoration (<ref="Neh. 3:1; 12:39; Jer. 31:38; Zech. 14:10">Neh. 3:1; 12:39; Jer. 31:38; Zech. 14:10</ref>).
